title: Fixed Empty Contoured Rescue Basket and Skids
description: One independently authored complete empty rescue-basket-style static prop. A continuous thick long tapered trough has a broad raised head field, narrower upturned foot field, full concave floor and six actual lateral upper grip openings. One complete tubular perimeter ring follows the entire contoured rim. Two complete fixed transverse bands with small solid connector appearances span the otherwise empty bowl; two whole low longitudinal skids root beneath its floor. No high wheel chassis, crossed cot legs, separate suspended basket or surrounding vat is included. All shell stations and other numeric geometry newly authored, not an old bed or basket elongated or extracted. Three opaque PBR roles, metres Z-up, horizontal bounds-centred ground origin, one whole prop zero scenes. Empty occupational visual art only: no human model, patient fit, medical treatment, restraint action, lifting, carrying capacity, transport, load, stability, manufacture, certification or rescue/medical use-safety claim. Rigging animation and interaction not made.
